description: Settings for the extension-managed Shopware MCP server. A custom context_servers.shopware-lsp.command bypasses these settings and this schema: provide a complete command object with path and args, for example {"path":"/absolute/path/shopware-lsp","args":["-root","/path/to/shopware","mcp"]}.

root.description: Absolute path to the Shopware or Symfony project root. Defaults to the root reported by the language server, then to the working directory. Ignored when a custom command is configured; pass -root before mcp in command.args instead.
